Fit a PEPI model using Stan and update the PEPI object

Source: R/fitters.R
fit_pepi.Rd

This function takes a PEPI object, fits a tumor evolutionary model using Stan, and updates the PEPI object with the fitted model and Stan data.

Usage

fit_pepi(
  pepi,
  model_type = "logistic",
  ms_driver_n = NULL,
  sigma_driver_n = NULL,
  ms_dc = NULL,
  sigma_dc = NULL,
  ms_cd = NULL,
  sigma_cd = NULL,
  alpha_lambda = 1,
  beta_lambda = 1,
  alpha_plus = 10,
  beta_plus = 250,
  alpha_minus = 10,
  beta_minus = 250,
  alpha_n = 0.5,
  beta_n = 20,
  alpha_p = 0.2,
  beta_p = 10,
  t_min = 0,
  ms_epi = 0,
  sigma_epi = 0.5,
  ccf_thr_clade = 0.05,
  ccf_thr_count = 0.02,
  include_bp = FALSE,
  n_chains = 4,
  parallel_chains = 4,
  adapt_delta = 0.8,
  iter_warmup = 1000,
  iter_sampling = 1000,
  seed = 1
)

Arguments

pepi

A PEPI object containing clade statistics, counts, and genomic constants.

model_type

Character. Functional form of the ω_⊕ prior. Options: "logistic" (default), "gumbel", or "log".

ms_driver_n

Numeric vector. Mean (μ) of the lognormal prior for drivers of type driver_n. Default automatically set if NULL.

sigma_driver_n

Numeric vector. Standard deviation (σ) of the lognormal prior for drivers of type driver_n. Default automatically set if NULL.

ms_dc

Numeric vector. Mean of the lognormal prior for dc drivers. Default automatically set if NULL.

sigma_dc

Numeric vector. Standard deviation of the lognormal prior for dc drivers. Default automatically set if NULL.

ms_cd

Numeric vector. Mean of the lognormal prior for cd drivers. Default automatically set if NULL.

sigma_cd

Numeric vector. Standard deviation of the lognormal prior for cd drivers. Default automatically set if NULL.

alpha_lambda

Numeric. Shape parameter of the Gamma prior on the baseline population growth rate λ.

beta_lambda

Numeric. Rate parameter of the Gamma prior on the baseline population growth rate λ.

alpha_plus

Numeric. Shape parameter of the Gamma prior on the variance of Gaussian observation noise for counts in the ⊕ epistate.

beta_plus

Numeric. Rate parameter of the Gamma prior on the variance of Gaussian observation noise for counts in the ⊕ epistate.

alpha_minus

Numeric. Shape parameter of the Gamma prior on the variance of Gaussian observation noise for counts in the ⊖ epistate.

beta_minus

Numeric. Rate parameter of the Gamma prior on the variance of Gaussian observation noise for counts in the ⊖ epistate.

alpha_n

Numeric. Shape parameter of the Gamma prior on the epigenetic switching rate ω_n (⊖ → ⊕).

beta_n

Numeric. Rate parameter of the Gamma prior on ω_n.

alpha_p

Numeric. Shape parameter of the Gamma prior on the epigenetic switching rate ω_p (⊕ → ⊖).

beta_p

Numeric. Rate parameter of the Gamma prior on ω_p.

t_min

Numeric. Lower bound for the prior on the time to the most recent common ancestor (MRCA) of clades and driver lineages, relative to the most recent sampling time.

ms_epi

Numeric. Mean (μ) of the lognormal prior on the fitness advantage of the positive epistate (⊕).

sigma_epi

Numeric. Standard deviation (σ) of the lognormal prior on the fitness advantage of the positive epistate (⊕).

ccf_thr_clade

Numeric. Minimum cancer cell fraction (CCF) threshold for clades to be included in the inference.

ccf_thr_count

Numeric. Minimum CCF threshold for population counts to be included in the inference.

include_bp

Logical. If TRUE, includes branching-process–based terms for the total positive (⊕) counts at the first time point in the likelihood. Default FALSE.

n_chains

Integer. Number of Markov chains to run in Stan. Default 4.

parallel_chains

Integer. Number of chains to run in parallel. Default 1.

adapt_delta

Numeric. Target acceptance probability for the Stan NUTS sampler. Default 0.8.

iter_warmup

Integer. Number of warmup (burn-in) iterations per chain. Default 1000.

iter_sampling

Integer. Number of sampling iterations per chain. Default 1000.

seed

Integer. Random seed for reproducibility. Default 1.

Value

A PEPI object updated with:

stan_data

The Stan data list used for fitting.

fit

The fitted cmdstanr::CmdStanMCMC object.

Details

Fit the PEPI Bayesian model

This function fits the PEPI Bayesian model to bulk sequencing and longitudinal population counts, jointly inferring clonal structure, driver expansions, epigenetic switching, and fitness advantages of the positive epistate (⊕).
